text:
Codex MultiAgentV2 config nuance:

features.multi_agent_v2 + agents.max_threads still fails validation.

But catalog-selected v2 models can ignore that legacy v1 cap, so older config may keep starting.

Source: https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/26254
evidence_notes: The social_candidate/v1 artifact has decision.worthiness = publish and mode practical_explainer for openai-codex-pr-26254.
The upstream_review/v1 artifact confirms that explicit features.multi_agent_v2 plus agents.max_threads remains invalid, while catalog-selected MultiAgentV2 can start with the legacy cap present.
The upstream_impact/v1 artifact marks the change as public_signal_decision publish, control_plane_impact compat_risk, and publisher_angle practical_explainer.

claims.text: Explicit features.multi_agent_v2 plus agents.max_threads remains invalid upstream.
Catalog-selected MultiAgentV2 can start while legacy agents.max_threads is present.
The PR #26254 practical explainer is live on @decodexspace.

decision.reason: The change is a clear, source-backed config migration note with practical operator value.

caveats: No media was attached; this single practical_explainer remains useful text-only because the reader value is the source-backed config distinction and direct PR link.
Do not imply Decodex runtime adoption of upstream model catalog selectors.
The behavior depends on upstream model metadata selecting MultiAgentV2; users explicitly enabling features.multi_agent_v2 still need to remove agents.max_threads.

post_lifecycle.reason: This is a standalone practical explainer, not a prerelease quote-chain anchor.
